_meta.description: Okinawan (Uchinaaguchi) vocabulary harvested from machine-readable Wiktionary data on Kaikki.org. Entries span interjections, phrases, adjectives, adverbs, verbs, pronouns, particles, counters, numerals, and common everyday nouns (food, family, body, nature, animals, time, people, places). Headwords are given in kana/kanji as shown on Kaikki; romaji is a best-effort Hepburn-style transliteration of the kana reading with long vowels doubled.
_meta.status_note: All entries needs_validation; romanization is best-effort pending fluent-speaker review.
